notes.title: Version 30 - New Minigame, Engine Update, MacOS Release & More!
notes.notes:
[h3]We're still here![/h3]

It has been a while since we last did an update. We have been hard at work setting up our game studio, which unfortunately got in the way of this update.

As reflected on the store page, we've started a game studio, the game is no longer just by Voltseon and ENLS, but by our studio: Solshade Games. The in game credits now also reflect this.

We have also managed to get the game working for MacOS, so welcome Mac users!

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mac Support
[*]A new second type of minigame can be encountered
[*]Localized for the "Turn Around" effect
[*]Confirmation when changing screen resolution
[*]You can now see your personal placement in the leaderboard at all times
[*]Shortcut to reset your settings (in case you are unable to reach the button) by pressing Shift + Delete in the settings screen
[*]The Bulgarian language
[*]Discord Rich Presence
[*]Added a discord button to [url=https://discord.gg/zcQXraG8C8]join our discord community[/url]
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[*]Minigames will now appear more frequently (7.5% > 10%)
[*]Increased leaderboard size (50 entries > 100 entries)
[*]Fixed Belarusian displaying as Bulgarian
[*]Updated the base engine, this will (hopefully) reduce lag spikes previously encountered when first playing the game
[*]Credits now show the Solshade Games logo instead of Voltseon & ENLS

We would also like to thank everyone for the support, we're very grateful for all the positive reviews and we hope to be supplying everyone with more great games!

Version 30

notes.title: Version 28 - Minor UI fixes
notes.notes:
Some minor fixes relating to UI:
[list]
[*] Tabs in various menus will no longer resize based on selection
[*] The leaderboard will now be aligned correctly when changing UI scale
[*] Uninitialized stats are no longer shown in the stats screen
[*] A brief message is shown when loading leaderboard data or when no data / stats are available
[*] When no language is set, the user's system language or language from steam is used.
[/list]

Version 28
